verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal docs describe managing multiple readers via locations/zones and registering readers individually, but there is no evidence of a bulk/batch API (e.g., batch payment processing, bulk reader configuration, or bulk refunds) that an AI agent could invoke to operate on many items in a single call. missing for 10: batch/bulk API endpoints for Terminal, evidence of programmatic bulk operations on payments or readers, AI-agent-oriented bulk automation examples.
